neighbours.label: the word opening the explained clause after an explanatory frame ('one reason that', 'this is why some', 'it is interesting that')
fire: Soil loses nutrients quickly, which is one reason that farmers rotate fields.
The pass is often closed. This is why most hikers start in July.
It is worth noting that the earliest charts leave out the reef.
Heat ruins the leaves. That is why many growers pick at dawn.
Salt draws out moisture, which is the reason that cooks brine meat.
The roads flood each spring, which explains why some villages move uphill.
It is telling that the founders never mentioned the river.
Light travels slowly in glass. This is why some lenses bend colors differently.
quiet: Soil loses nutrients quickly, so farmers rotate their fields each year.
The pass is often closed, and most hikers start in July.
The earliest charts of the coast leave out the reef entirely.
Heat ruins the leaves, and many growers pick at dawn.
Salt draws out moisture, and cooks often brine meat.
The roads flood each spring, and some villages move uphill.
The founders never mentioned the river in their letters.
Light travels slowly in glass, and lenses bend colors differently.
